extDescription.message: Copy a GitHub pull request as a clean, shareable one-liner for chat apps like Slack.

errorNotAPr.message: Open a GitHub pull request to copy it.

errorDetailsNotFound.message: Couldn't read the pull request details. Wait for the page to load and try again.

errorNeedsToken.message: Couldn't read this pull request. If the repository is private, add a GitHub token in the PR Clip options.

optionsSubtitle.message: Choose how pull requests are copied.

placeholderHint.message: Click a placeholder to insert it:

tokenDescription.message: PR Clip reads details from the page and falls back to the GitHub API when it can't. Private repositories need a fine-grained token with read-only "Pull requests" access. It's stored only on this device and sent only to api.github.com.

tokenSavedPlaceholder.message: Token saved — enter a new one to replace it
